parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Correct shape, i.e. 3 branches then 3 by 3 branches, labelled and clear annotation — M1. Guidance: Condone omission of lines for first match result providing the probabilities are there.
All correct probabilities with fully correct shape and probabilities, either fractions or decimals, not 1.5/5 etc. — A1.
Total: 2.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(L_1\mid W_2)=\dfrac{P(L_1\cap W_2)}{P(W_2)}$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt at $P(L_1\cap W_2)$ as a two-factor product only as numerator or denominator of a fraction.
$=\dfrac{1/5\times3/10}{3/5\times7/10+1/5\times1/3+1/5\times3/10}$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt at $P(W_2)$ as sum of appropriate 3 two-factor probabilities oe seen anywhere.
A1. Guidance: Unsimplified correct $P(W_2)$ numerator or denominator of a fraction.
$=\dfrac{3/50}{41/75}=9/82$ (0.110) — A1.
Total: 4.
